Maya Chen: Vega Systems invoice arrived, amount $12,450, PDF no PO. Vendor threatened late fee if not paid by month-end.
Priya Sinha: Invoice ID VS-2026-0389? I can't match it in Coupa.
Maya Chen: Yes VS-2026-0389, vendor ref 99823. Charges: dedicated GPUs, storage delta, egress.
Ava Li: That should be on PO-7782 (EngPlatform). Vendor probably used an old PO.
Priya Sinha: Auto-match failed. FinanceBot flagged: NO_PO_MATCH -> PAYMENT_HOLD.
FinanceBot: AP ticket AP-54231 created by Priya Sinha. Approvers required: Ava Li, Josef R.
Maya Chen: Vendor offered bank transfer if ACH blocked. Asking for one-time exception.
Josef R: FP&A note: if EngPlatform cost center 220-EP and GL 6002 confirmed, I can approve override.
Ava Li: Confirm cost center 220-EP. I approve one-time payment pending Josef's signoff and note that vendor should reissue with PO-7782.
Josef R: Approved. Please add note "vendor billed wrong PO; reissue requested" in AP ticket.
FinanceBot: Approvals received. PAYMENT_HOLD cleared. Payment scheduled for run on 2026-03-30.
Maya Chen: I'll tell Vega we're processing payment and request corrected invoice format going forward. Priya, please close AP-54231 after payment posts.
